paragraphs: R. Yitzḥak bar Meron; in Shoḥer Tov, §78, and Ḥazit, at 'My beloved is like a gazelle': bar Marion. R. Aivu, R. Bivi, and Rav Huna, in R. Yitzḥak bar Marion's name, Midrash Kohelet, at 'He has made everything beautiful in its time.' R. Zekharyah and R. Yonatan bar Ḥaggai, in his name, Midrash Shemuel, chapter 22. And R. Yirmeyah, R. Abbahu, in R. Ḥanina's name, Jerusalem Talmud, end of chapter HaBa Al Yevimto. In the name of R. Yose bar Ḥanina. In Resh Lakish's name, Yalkut Tehillim (§103).
